chapter: Listening to the Troy Floyd records
title: Working up the blues without written arrangements
summary: Albert says the blues ideas were his, Charlie Dixon's and Cy Kye Collins's, with no written arrangements and little rehearsal; the band played the number in clubs first, at Shadowland, with Alan Vann on piano.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered
